question: How many Ramsar Sites does India now have in total? (As of June 2025)
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**91**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Two more Ramsar wetland sites in India, taking the total to 91

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 
Recent additions to the list in September 2025 include **Gokul Reservoir **and **Udaipur Lake** in Bihar, bringing the total number of sites to 96.

 
 
• 
 
Two new wetlands in Rajasthan, **Khichan (Phalodi)** and **Menar (Udaipur)** declared as **Ramsar Sites**.

 
 
• 
 
Total **Ramsar Sites in India** now: **98 **– **highest in Asia**.

 
 
• 
 
Rajasthan now has **4 Ramsar Sites**:

 
 
• 
 
**Sambhar Salt Lake**

 
 
• 
 
**Keoladeo National Park**

 
 
• 
 
**Khichan**

 
 
• 
 
**Menar**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Timeline**:

 
 
• 
 
J**une 2025 (91 Sites)**: Khichan Wetland and Menar Wetland Complex (Rajasthan) added on World Environment Day. 

 
 
• 
 
**September 2025 (93 Sites)**: Gokul Jalashay and Udaipur Jheel (Bihar) officially designated. 

 
 
• 
 
**October 2025 (94 Sites)**: Gogabeel Lake (Bihar) recognized as the 94th site.

 
 
• 
 
**December 2025 (96 Sites)**: Siliserh Lake (Rajasthan) and Kopra Jalashay (Chhattisgarh) added; Kopra Jalashay is Chhattisgarh's first Ramsar site. 

 
 
• 
 
**January 30, 2026 (98 Sites)**: Patna Bird Sanctuary (Uttar Pradesh) and Chhari-Dhand (Gujarat) were designated ahead of World Wetlands Day 2026.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
**Ramsar Convention** was adopted in **1971** in **Ramsar, Iran**.

 
 
• 
 
It aims for **conservation and wise use** of **wetlands globally**.

 
 
• 
 
**India joined Ramsar Convention** in **1982**.
